description: Open-transition (break-before-make) automatic transfer switch with its controller: voltage sensing on both sources, transfer and retransfer timers and the genset start contact. The asset source has no record of it; it sits in the MSB and L1 DB switchgear (graphene supplement electrical.json).

fail_to_transfer.description: The switch mechanism holds its current position and ignores transfer commands.

name: Automatic transfer switch

initial_position.description: Switch position at start: 0 open, 1 normal source, 2 emergency source.

emergency_in.description: Emergency source (genset bus or the other MSB side).

normal_in.description: Normal source (utility transformers or this side's MSB).

power_out.description: Load side: the bus this switch supplies.
